name: Tonoshō (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tonoshō town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears crossed by a diagonal stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Tonoshō, a town in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1963.

features.role: Tonoshō town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears crossed by a diagonal stroke
